These spears belong to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Rito-made Weapons. They are lightweight and made of sturdy materials, which allow Rito warriors to use them in aerial combat. The guards of [[Rito Village]], [[Gesane]] and [[Mazli]], wield them. They are also used by [[Enemy|Enemies]] on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in [[Hyrule Field]]. Being made of metal, Feathered Spears will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will sink if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
